newsitem.title: HUNGARY: KREDIETBANK SAYS BIDS FOR HUNGARY BANK.
newsitem.headline: KREDIETBANK SAYS BIDS FOR HUNGARY BANK.

text.p: Belgium's Kredietbank confirmed on Wednesday press reports that it submitted a bid for the privatisation of Kereskedelmi (K&H), one of Hungary's largest banks.
"We did submit a bid," Agnes Hitesy, head of Kredietbank's Budapest representative gffice told Reuters. 8 The state privatisation agency APV said on Monday that five investors bid for K&H.
APV plans to decide on April 23 on which investors qualify for the second round of the tender.
Press reports said the bidders included Holland's ING Bank and Belgium's Kredietbank.

Hungary plans to sell a stake of at least 25 percent plus one vote in K&H to a strategic investor, who will have the right to invite a financial investor to raise the bank's equity at a later date by a minimum $30 million.
